_comment: Auto-equip on the LOADOUT screen (DESIGN.md §16.6), loaded by LoadoutPlanner (checked on load: LoadoutPlanner.problems()). Scores are points; higher is better. armor: a piece's protection is, over each zone it covers, the zone's weight × ArmorRules.resistance(class, durability left): 10 per class, falling to half as it wears and to 0 worn out, plus a helmet's fitted face shield, minus weight_penalty per kg (the piece with its parts), plus hearing points for +100% hearing (GearUpgrades.hearing() of the piece and its parts: negative for most helmets and masks, so they cost). Head and thorax are vital (and the face is the head); the stomach, arms and legs weigh little, so a higher class wins and coverage only breaks a near-tie. A helmet and a face cover are scored as a pair: over the face only the piece that stops more counts. carry: a rig's or backpack's room, cell points per cell of its grid (at its upgrade level) minus weight_penalty per kg; an armored rig scores its room and its protection, and body armor + rig is weighed against an armored rig alone. gun: from WeaponStats with its parts and your skills: ergonomics (per point), vertical_recoil and horizontal_recoil (per degree, against), base_spread (per degree, against), durability (at 100 of 100), jam_chance (per % per shot, against), fire_rate (per round a minute), plus ammo × the best round you own for it. ammo: penetration + damage × pellets^pellet_exponent (per round). hearing: points for +100% hearing (headsets; well above armor.hearing, as a headset's slot is for hearing). melee_damage: points per point of damage. rarity_epsilon: scores this close count as a tie and the rarer item wins. upgrade: a worn item is replaced only by one that scores more than its score + max(min, |score| × margin). spare_magazines: spare rounds carried per gun, in magazines' worth (rounds you carry count when they're as good as the stash's; worse ones go back to the stash for better). meds: what goes in the pockets or rig, one of each kind (by the med's "type" stat), unless you carry one there already.
